newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-Reuters raised at Lehman.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Reuters raised at Lehman.

text.p: News and information group Reuters Holdings Plc was raised to "outperform" from "neutral" at Lehman Brothers, the investment bank said on Thursday.

Setting a price target of 700p on the stock, analyst Carlo Campomagnani said an analysis of Wednesday's results from the news and financial information company showed good underlying growth with margins growing faster than he had expected.
He also noted that Reuters' 3000 series was on target to reach 30,000 units sold by year-end, with 17 percent sold to new customers which would gradually start to boost sales.

Campomagnani said the recent underperformance by Reuters shares had discounted an unfavourable currency environment and constraints on cash distribution, which held Wednesday's share buyback to 200 million stg.
The stock was up 8-1/2p at 607 by 0952 GMT, reversing some of Wednesday's 11p decline.
